mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CRAWL_RUN (RUN_ID, STATUS, KEYWORD, RUN_TYPE, STARTED_AT) VALUES (#{runId}, 'RUNNING', #{keyword}, #{runType}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CRAWL_RUN SET STATUS = 'FAIL' , ENDED_AT = SYSDATE , ERROR_MSG = #{errorMsg} WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT RUN_ID, RUN_TYPE, STATUS, KEYWORD, STARTED_AT, ENDED_AT, PAGE_COUNT, FETCHED_CNT, INSERTED_CNT, UPDATED_CNT, FAILED_CNT, ERROR_MSG FROM TB_CRAWL_RUN WHERE RUN_ID = #{runId}
